name: TextSearchRequest
description: Request body for a Text Search.

textQuery.description: The free-form text query to search for.

includedType.description: Restrict results to a single place type.

maxResultCount.description: The maximum number of results to return (1-20).

openNow.description: Restrict results to places that are currently open.

minRating.description: Restrict results to places with at least this average rating.

languageCode.description: The language in which to return results.

regionCode.description: The region code used to format and bias the response.

locationBias.description: The region to bias results toward, expressed as a circle.
